assets.role: Design anchor for every later shot of the house
assets.prompt: Architectural photograph of a single contemporary luxury villa on the edge of the desert near Dubai, seen from the quiet street at eye level, 24 mm lens, centred composition. Two storeys of long, low horizontal volumes clad in honed warm-ivory travertine laid in long horizontal courses, thin flat cantilevered roof planes with deep shadows, floor-to-ceiling low-iron glass with slim bronze frames, vertical European oak screens across the upper floor, a 3.6 m solid oak pivot front door. In front, a planted arrival courtyard behind a low travertine wall: olive trees, one sculptural ghaf tree, gravel and large travertine paving slabs, small in-ground path lights. Tall date palms along the street. Late golden hour, warm low sun from the left, long soft shadows, clear sky. Calm, expensive, understated. Photorealistic, natural colours, high detail. No people, no cars, no text, no logos, no watermark.
